definitions: A region around a charged particle or object within which a force would be exerted on other charged particles or objects.
A vector field that associates to each point in space the force per unit charge that would be experienced by a vanishingly small positive test charge at that point.
examples: The electric field lines originate from positive charges and terminate on negative charges.
A strong electric field can ionize the air.
The strength of the electric field decreases with distance from the source.
